LESSON: SARUFI 6.4.1 VIVUMISHI SIFA VIASHIRIA

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.4: Sarufi 6.4.1 Vivumishi sifa viashiria

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 6.4.1 Vivumishi sifa viashiria. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria/vionyeshi katika matini
2. kutumia vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria/vionyeshi ipasavyo katika matini

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria/vionyeshi katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria/vionyeshi katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutumia vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria/vionyeshi ipasavyo katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria/vionyeshi ipasavyo katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 6.4.1 Vivumishi sifa viashiria using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 6.4.1 Vivumishi sifa viashiria in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 6.4.1 Vivumishi sifa viashiria to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 6.4.1 Vivumishi sifa viashiria.
4. Show that you can: kutambua vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria/vionyeshi katika matini

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 6.4.1 Vivumishi sifa viashiria using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 6.4.1 Vivumishi sifa viashiria important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria/vionyeshi katika matini
2. kutumia vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria/vionyeshi ipasavyo katika matini

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
